thought.text: All 31 top-level projects locked. Now the demospipes sub-projects:

reasoning_content:
All 31 top-level projects are locked. Next, the sub-projects of demospipes:
- 02-backend/demospipes/api
- 02-backend/demospipes/core
- 02-backend/demospipes/data-structures
- 02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/api
- 02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/executors
- 02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/data_structures

Also, should I lock the sub-projects of 02-backend/demospipes? The Dockerfiles for api/core/bmds reference `uv sync --locked`, and each needs a uv.lock in the respective directory.

Additionally, let me also check the tex2pdf-service workspace — the root pyproject is `package = false` and has workspace members. The root `uv lock` should have covered the entire workspace.

Let's lock the demospipes sub-projects.

action.command:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cd /workspace && for d in 02-backend/demospipes/api 02-backend/demospipes/core 02-backend/demospipes/data-structures 02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/api 02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/executors 02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/data_structures; do
  [ -f "$d/pyproject.toml" ] || { echo "SKIP $d"; continue; }
  ( cd "$d" && timeout 300 uv lock >/tmp/lock_$(basename $d).log 2>&1 && echo "LOCKED $d" || { echo "FAILED $d"; tail -5 /tmp/lock_$(basename $d).log; } )
done
